events.description: Ross Geller says everyone told Ross Geller to pick a major.

Ross Geller says Ben Geller has no idea what Ross Geller is saying.

Ross Geller says Ben Geller is a fetus.
Ross Geller says Ben Geller is happy that Ben Geller no longer has gills.
Ross Geller says Ben Geller does not have gills anymore.
Carol Willick tells Ross Geller to look.

Carol Willick says Ross Geller can sing to Ben Geller if Ross Geller wants to.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller is not going to sing to Carol Willick's stomach.
Susan Bunch asks how the situation is going.

Ross Geller says Carol Willick just felt Ben Geller move.
Carol Willick says Carol Willick did feel Ben Geller move.
Ross Geller asks whether Ben Geller always moves like that.
Carol Willick says that movement was the first time Ben Geller moved.
Susan Bunch tells Ross Geller to keep singing.

Ross Geller says Ben Geller is Ross Geller's baby, Ross Geller cannot wait to meet Ben Geller, after Ben Geller is born Ross Geller will buy Ben Geller a bagel, and then Ross Geller and Ben Geller will go to the zoo.
Susan Bunch says Susan Bunch felt Ben Geller move.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller is Ben Geller's daddy and is the one without any breasts.
